📈 What moved today, Thursday 26 November

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 rose 1.8% to 98,596. Resource shares jumped 4%, with platinum up 3.4%. Banks, insurers and industrials gained about 1%.

💱 The rand was steady at about R17.53 to the dollar. Brent oil rose 1.5% to about $96.

What it means for you: a broad up day lifts retirement and unit-trust balances, but oil near $96 still works against the December petrol cut.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
